title: 05.07 - What to do if a contribution was not submitted on time
intent: Explain what participants should do when they miss a submission deadline or their contribution is not submitted in time.
short_answer: Contact the survey organisers directly. If the survey organisers’ contact details are not available on the survey page, contact the EUSurvey support team.
procedure: Check the survey page for contact details of the survey organisers.
Contact the survey organisers and explain that your contribution was not submitted on time.
If no organiser contact details are available, contact EUSurvey support: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/home/support.
important_conditions: Survey deadlines and acceptance of late contributions are managed by the survey organisers.
EUSurvey support can help with technical issues but may not be able to change survey-specific deadlines.
